verdict.rationale: BVNK is a payments infrastructure platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint. The llms.txt file and the agent-wallet CLI are adjacent artifacts belonging to other stories, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
